# The current account

*What the record now holds about how its own claims fit together, one line
of argument at a time. Generated from the SYNTHESIS entries in
`record/syntheses.d/`: edit those, not this page.*

A synthesis says what its components add up to, and which admission route it
passed: an independent hypothesis, a derived result or an explanatory
integration ([ADR-075](../record/decisions.d/ADR-075.md)). Its components keep their own standing. The status
beside each component, with its kind, is read from the component when this
page is built, so a component retired since the synthesis was written shows as
retired here. An `Open` QUESTION, an `Active` TERM and a `Proposed` CLAIM are
different kinds of standing, which is why the kind is shown. Only admitted
syntheses appear; an unadmitted one is kept in its file, not set out here.
A synthesis marked *Current* is the account the owner has adopted for its
line; *Proposed* is admitted and argued, not yet adopted. A synthesis that
spans several lines is set out under its first and pointed to from the
others.

## Distributed agency

what an organized whole is, and how its operative direction relates to its members' — where the essay started

### [SYNTHESIS-006](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-006.md): From interconnection to individuation, the relationships are distinct achievements that form a partial order, not a nested sequence: none implies the next, and a later one need not require every earlier one. Interconnection fixes what joint behaviour is possible, compatibility which local descriptions admit a coherent whole, dynamics which organizations persist, individuation which have sufficiently robust identity and boundaries, organizational autonomy which help maintain their own constitutive constraints, and inquiry which can measure and revise their own models and apparatuses under resource bounds, inquiry and reconstruction occurring without autonomy. The research program is to find the conditions for each, and their dependencies, apart from the order in which an inquiry meets them

*Current · hypothesis · thesis · warrant interpretive · version 1*

Filed as [CLAIM-474](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-474.md) at the owner's review of 2026-10-27, which asked for a synthesis "From Interconnection to Individuation: A Relational Constraint Research Program" that would make the theory "legible as a research program with distinct testable transitions, rather than a cluster of philosophically suggestive analogies". It references the record's claims rather than restating them: the places where one achievement does not yield the next, each with a source the record has read. Its premises, [CLAIM-471](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-471.md), [CLAIM-480](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-480.md), [CLAIM-481](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-481.md), [CLAIM-470](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-470.md) and [CLAIM-475](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-475.md), are Active. The central experiment is [CASE-179](../record/cases.d/CASE-179.md). Moved into the SYNTHESIS scheme on 2026-11-07 ([ADR-077](../record/decisions.d/ADR-077.md)), keeping the standing the status review of 2026-11-06 gave it under the rulings the owner delegated.

| component | kind | its status | what it holds |
|---|---|---|---|
| [CLAIM-471](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-471.md) (premise) | CLAIM | Active | Physical interconnection can generate effective constraints on joint behaviour; measurement can estimate correspondences among local descriptions; and adaptive apparatuses can revise those correspondences; gluing expresses compatibility under specified relations, but neither the relations' physical generation nor their adequacy follows from gluing alone |
| [CLAIM-480](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-480.md) (premise) | CLAIM | Active | Composing interactions can turn an interior into a constraint, and sometimes into a constraint of a new kind: in the chain E = ½k₁(x₁ − x₂)² + ½k₂(x₂ − x₃)², with x₂ internal and equilibrated, the boundary sees E_eff = ½·k₁k₂/(k₁ + k₂)·(x₁ − x₃)², a coupling between x₁ and x₃ that neither part has; if the interior relaxes slowly, eliminating it leaves a history-dependent constraint, a memory kernel, so interconnection fixes an effective constraint on the boundary's trajectories and separation of time scales decides only whether that constraint is approximately memoryless; and for cellular sheaves the reduced constraint can relate three boundary values where every relation among the parts is pairwise |
| [CLAIM-481](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-481.md) (premise) | CLAIM | Active | Coupling does not by itself separate time scales: two identical undamped oscillators coupled with stiffness k have normal modes at ω₀ and √(ω₀² + 2k), nearly equal when k ≪ ω₀², and neither decays; separation comes where the coupling dissipates relative differences faster than collective ones, as in ẋ = −ax − k(x − y), ẏ = −ay − k(y − x), whose collective and relative modes relax at rates a and a + 2k, and in a Laplacian flow ẋ = −κLx, where the spectrum of L sets the rates |
| [CLAIM-470](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-470.md) (premise) | CLAIM | Active | Inquiry is a form of specification: a question fixes which differences would count as an answer, an inquiry adds the operations that make those differences accessible, and what it finds can stabilize into a specification that constrains later inquiry; so inquiry stands to its findings as a specification to its realizations, with one difference, that an inquiry can revise what an answer could be |
| [CLAIM-475](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-475.md) (premise) | CLAIM | Active | Specifying is itself a resource-bounded realization: formulating a question takes time, concepts and computation as realizing a configuration takes energy and matter, so the questions an agent can ask are a product of what it has already realized; a stabilized specification is past inquiry stored so that later questions become cheaper to ask, and it can make other questions harder |
| [CLAIM-143](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-143.md) | CLAIM | Active | Local descriptions that disagree are not thereby incompatible: whether there is an obstruction can be assessed only relative to a specified class of admissible correspondences between their observations, independently validated and not admitted because they remove the disagreement |
| [CLAIM-478](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-478.md) | CLAIM | Proposed | Scale separation helps make structure and not only marks it: where some degrees of freedom settle fast relative to others, the relation they settle into is a constraint on the system over the window between the two time scales, so what is a realization at one scale works as a constraint at another; and organization can make new separations in turn, as when modes slow near an instability and become order parameters, so time-scale hierarchies and constraints can produce one another |
| [CLAIM-157](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-157.md) | CLAIM | Proposed | Relative to a stated target, a combined form is one system while its joint dynamics are nearly decomposable with the form as a block whose gap beats the Occam factor, and it lasts as long as that block persists; the unit is the gap-isolated block, not any member |
| [CLAIM-395](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-395.md) | CLAIM | Active | Under Montévil and Mossio's definition of closure, a closed set of constraints has at least two members, and if each constraint is produced at the time scale of a constraint in the set that generates it and not at the scale at which it is itself conserved, the set includes at least one slow and one fast dependence, so a system with a single constraint of its own cannot realise closure |
| [CLAIM-469](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-469.md) | CLAIM | Active | Luria is an apparatus for a record's objects in the operational sense: through its schemes, vocabularies, validators and generated views it realizes a system of distinctions that fixes what counts as a referable and governable object within the record, so that a split scheme makes one object two and a promoted vocabulary makes a value an entity; it keeps, enforces and propagates those distinctions; and its distinctions are revised through the record's own use |
| [THEORY-012](../record/theory.d/THEORY-012.md) | THEORY | Active | An empirical model is Kochen–Specker-noncontextual exactly when its context distributions glue to one global distribution, and since signed global sections always exist for no-signalling models, negative probability does not mark contextuality |
| [CASE-179](../record/cases.d/CASE-179.md) | CASE | Active | A proposed study: one network of locally described units in which physical coupling, the correspondence maps that say which local states agree, and the apparatus that revises those maps are manipulated independently, to find which of compatibility, attraction, effective boundary constraint, persistent individuation and reliable revision come apart, and how much each costs to establish |

**What would defeat the integration:** A general result that collapses two adjacent steps: for instance, that for physically interconnected systems compatible configurations are always attracting, that a persistent collective mode always has robust boundaries and maintains its constraints, or that an apparatus that revises its own discriminations always becomes more reliable. Any such result, holding beyond a special class, would make the five relationships fewer and the program different. A class is special only if it is narrower than the class the record applies the step to: dissipative Laplacian flows, in which compatibility and attraction go together ([CLAIM-481](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-481.md)), are one; every system with a robust boundary is not. Also defeated as a synthesis of its own if it only lists the separations [CLAIM-471](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-471.md), [CLAIM-480](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-480.md), [CLAIM-481](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-481.md), [CLAIM-470](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-470.md) and [CLAIM-475](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-475.md) each hold, saying nothing about the order they form. The claim is that no step implies the next in general.
### [SYNTHESIS-001](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-001.md): An organized individual's identity over time is carried by the causal transmission of the relations that keep its repertoire realizable, not by its constituents or by any structure invariant across its realizations, so a structuralism about individuals has to be historical: the structure can change under maps that are not isomorphisms while the individual continues, two structurally identical copies can be two individuals, the transmitting organization may lie outside the individual, and when those relations part at a succession, different successors can continue different respects of it

*Proposed · hypothesis · thesis · warrant interpretive · version 1*

The thesis of U14 to U17 of the exchange "Individuation, Possibility, and Disposition" (2026-11-06 to 07), from A32 §12 to A37's "synthesis in one statement", the version filed. Much of it is the owner's. The owner proposed the software product as a model of an individual (U14), PyTorch and "a form of Structuralism" (U15), and the contested- succession study (U16, [CASE-223](../record/cases.d/CASE-223.md)). A37 tells the structuralism as joint ("What sort of structuralism have we arrived at?") and drops the owner's study design. The integration is A's: the owner's synchronic structural realism ([CLAIM-136](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-136.md)) is carried to persistence by [CLAIM-329](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-329.md)'s transmission criterion, applied to what [SYNTHESIS-003](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-003.md) says persists. Corrections are marked: "fission" becomes plural succession ([CLAIM-328](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-328.md)), the owner's contributions are credited, and the held entries the exchange never cited are named. The integration's wording is A's, corrected by the filer; adopting it is the owner's call. Moved from [CLAIM-615](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-615.md) into the SYNTHESIS scheme on 2026-11-07 ([ADR-076](../record/decisions.d/ADR-076.md)); it was admitted as an independent hypothesis under [ADR-075](../record/decisions.d/ADR-075.md).

| [CLAIM-329](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-329.md) (premise) | CLAIM | Proposed | A collective that replaces all its members persists, when it does, by causal transmission of the organization that produces it, not by resemblance: an organization of the same kind that arises independently is not its continuation, and a lapse in its coherence need not end it |

**What would defeat the integration:** A succession in which the relations that kept the predecessor's repertoire realizable were transmitted to a successor, and every criterion the record uses counts it not a continuation; or one in which nothing of that organization was transmitted and it must still be counted the same individual, as by continuity of constituents or by an invariant structure, the maintaining organization having been replaced by one with no causal tie to it. Not defeated by a community's verdict that disagrees with the transmission criterion, which the claim treats as a cause ([CLAIM-617](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-617.md)), not a criterion.
### [SYNTHESIS-002](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-002.md): The wrong beyond violation that an organization commits by reproducing representations and allocations of authority that keep a justified standard from constraining it is a breach of a second-order duty of answerability: to maintain feasible means for relevant violations to become knowable, contestable and correctable; it is a verdict only given an independently justified standard and a feasible alternative

*Proposed · hypothesis · thesis · warrant interpretive · version 2*

A's answer to the owner's U27 and U28 in the second share of the exchange "Individuation, Possibility, and Disposition" (2026-11-06 to 07): A60 §6 and §12 to §13, then A62 §3 and §13, one thesis in three versions, filed at its latest (A62 §13) under the synthesis audit of [ADR-075](../record/decisions.d/ADR-075.md). The question and its presupposition are the owner's ([CLAIM-614](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-614.md)). Most of its components are held: occlusion is [CLAIM-348](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-348.md) with [CASE-110](../record/cases.d/CASE-110.md), the reproductive structure A calls new is [CLAIM-445](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-445.md) and [TERM-020](../record/terms.d/TERM-020.md), and A62 §9 restates [CLAIM-462](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-462.md) uncited. What is A's is the second-order duty of answerability, the five-condition criterion and the claim that the wrong does not reduce to the loss. Corrections are marked. The wording is A's; adopting it is the owner's call. Moved from [CLAIM-624](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-624.md) into the SYNTHESIS scheme on 2026-11-07 ([ADR-076](../record/decisions.d/ADR-076.md)); it was admitted as an independent hypothesis under [ADR-075](../record/decisions.d/ADR-075.md).

### [SYNTHESIS-003](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-003.md): When an organized individual persists through changes of state and mode, in the dynamical and historical senses of persistence, what persists is the particular organization that keeps its repertoire realizable, not the repertoire it keeps, nor any state, mode or boundary; that organization may lie inside the individual or outside it

*Proposed · hypothesis · thesis · warrant interpretive · version 1*

A's thesis of the exchange "Individuation, Possibility, and Disposition" (2026-11-06 to 07) across U6 to U13, stated eight times from A14 §11 to A29 §11, the version filed. The owner set its course: the synchronization laboratory at U4, time-scale separation at U6 (the owner's [CLAIM-478](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-478.md)), synergetics at U7, "metastability, ergodicity, stationarity, absorbing states" at U10, and the sheaf/topos apparatus at U11. The integration, that an individual's organization lies in what keeps its repertoire realizable, is A's. A22 §10 credited A's own A20 sentence to the owner, and A29 §11 credits none of the owner's turns; both are corrected here. Four other corrections are marked in the body: the layers part, statistical persistence is no evidence, the maintaining organization may lie outside, and the owner's laboratory is restored. The integration's wording is A's, corrected by the filer; adopting it is the owner's call. Moved from [CLAIM-611](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-611.md) into the SYNTHESIS scheme on 2026-11-07 ([ADR-076](../record/decisions.d/ADR-076.md)); it was admitted as an independent hypothesis under [ADR-075](../record/decisions.d/ADR-075.md).

**What would defeat the integration:** One system whose maintaining organization is replaced by an unrelated one that keeps the same repertoire realizable ([CLAIM-522](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-522.md)'s outside controller swapped in), which every criterion the record uses counts as the same individual through the swap, so that the repertoire and not its maintainer is what persisted; or a case where an individual persists through a change in what is realizable for it, with no organization keeping anything realizable across the change, so that the repertoire is not what persisted. Also defeated as a thesis of its own if it only restates [CLAIM-576](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-576.md) (a constrained system is characterized by its repertoire of realizable processes), [CLAIM-025](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-025.md) (the operative, governing and transforming layers part) and [TERM-071](../record/terms.d/TERM-071.md)'s senses of persistence, saying nothing about where individuation lies. Not defeated by an individual that persists in one mode throughout, which the claim allows.

### [SYNTHESIS-008](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-008.md): Structural frustration of a set of demands forces, under every attainable arrangement, some member whose demand is unmet while it acts toward it, the precondition of operative thwarting, exactly when no attainable arrangement leaves each member either met or quiet; lying outside both the requirement complex and the quiescent complex does not suffice, the requirement complex is the test when every member acts whenever its demand is unmet, and in a minimal such conflict each member is the unmet, acting one under some arrangement and none is under all

*Proposed · derived · thesis · warrant demonstrated · version 1*

[QUESTION-131](../record/questions.d/QUESTION-131.md) asks when structural frustration among jointly incompatible demands shows up as operative thwarting, and which member is thwarted. Thwarting needs a member that acts toward its demand while the demand goes unmet. Putting [CLAIM-347](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-347.md)'s requirement complex beside [CLAIM-549](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-549.md)'s quiescent complex shows that neither decides when frustration forces such a member. A third complex decides it: the sets that some attainable arrangement leaves each member met or quiet. The result is derived and checked exhaustively on small instances. It is a necessary condition of thwarting, not an identification of thwarting, which still needs the causal evidence [CLAIM-357](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-357.md) and [QUESTION-131](../record/questions.d/QUESTION-131.md) ask for. Filed at the synthesis review of 2026-11-07 ([ADR-078](../record/decisions.d/ADR-078.md)). The integration's wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call.

## Contextual pragmatic information transport

what survives when an utterance is translated, retold or rendered in another medium — communicative identity as relationally organized observables, and fidelity as directed, task-relative transport between observational systems

### [SYNTHESIS-005](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-005.md): Concepts are individuated over time by the transmission criterion that governs organized individuals, so in reflexive social systems the coupling of meaning and will runs through what is transmitted and can remake the concepts, perspectives and organizations it runs in: meaning-making and individuation condition each other, without that persistence showing truth, consensus or autonomy

*Proposed · hypothesis · thesis · warrant interpretive · version 1*

The thesis of U18 to U21 of the exchange "Individuation, Possibility, and Disposition" (2026-11-06 to 07), from A39 §12 to A45 §XVI, the version filed, with A52 §17's revisions to its clauses. The owner set its course: meaning at U18, symbols and concepts with "anti-vax" and the organizational perspective at U19, and will at U20. Its integrating core, that meaning and will are one model, is the owner's [CLAIM-336](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-336.md) (2026-10-16). A45 cites it as "foreshadowed" and calls the unification "The crucial advance". What A adds is the step to individuation: concepts persist under the transmission criterion of [SYNTHESIS-001](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-001.md), and the loop between meaning and will is one way organizations individuate. Four of A45's misstatements are corrected and marked. Version 2 adds A57's and A58's coupling from the second share, at the owner's U26: a perspective's availability is a maintained legibility regime, and the action the will commits to fixes which distinctions must be legible ([CLAIM-535](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-535.md)). A58's corrections are marked, the owner's [CLAIM-553](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-553.md) among them. The integration's wording is A's, corrected by the filer; adopting it is the owner's call. Moved from [CLAIM-620](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-620.md) into the SYNTHESIS scheme on 2026-11-07 ([ADR-076](../record/decisions.d/ADR-076.md)); it was admitted as an independent hypothesis under [ADR-075](../record/decisions.d/ADR-075.md).

| [CLAIM-417](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-417.md) | CLAIM | Proposed | What the record explained by "self" in its dispositional, persisting, self-governing and integrated senses is better explained by organizational perspectives, with a perspective, its carriers, its lineage and its representations kept apart; the subject sense stays a separate question, and narrative, presented and modeled selves involve representations that may describe a perspective, attribute it to a bearer or construct an owner, none of them the perspective itself |
| [CLAIM-553](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-553.md) | CLAIM | Proposed | Give each of an individual's perspectives a scalar intervention threshold on its discrepancy from the will it wants effective: the intervention that can be observed is the propensity to mobilize times the chance that the discrepancy is legible and a channel carries the intervention, so a perspective that does not intervene has not thereby endorsed; and read through Frankfurt, wholeheartedness is the will that moves the individual to act lying within every perspective's tolerance, a full face of the requirement complex and not of the quiet one, so a structurally frustrated individual cannot act wholeheartedly unless its demands change |
| [TERM-073](../record/terms.d/TERM-073.md) | TERM | Active | interpretation, as a context-dependent determination of significance: a transformation that differentiates information and establishes or revises its consequences within an operative organization, defined without experience |

| [TERM-072](../record/terms.d/TERM-072.md) | TERM | Active | perspective, and which sense: organizational, represented or phenomenal |
| [TERM-023](../record/terms.d/TERM-023.md) | TERM | Active | will-organization |
| [TERM-099](../record/terms.d/TERM-099.md) | TERM | Active | self-formation, of an agent: the production, by the agent's own activity on a discrepancy it cannot yet resolve, of a maintained capacity, a new distinction it can make legible or a new channel by which it can act, that outlasts the discrepancy and serves a class of later ones |
| [TERM-064](../record/terms.d/TERM-064.md) | TERM | Active | legibility, of a distinction to an observer for a task: whether the observer, with the rules, categories and resources it actually has, can recover the distinction from what it is given and bring it to bear on the task; a relation among a representation, an observer's rule class, its resources and a task, bounded above by what the source makes possible for an ideal receiver, and directed, since what is legible to a governing institution and what of its governing is legible to others are different relations |

**What would defeat the integration:** A concept whose persistence the transmission criterion of [CLAIM-615](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-615.md) gets wrong, continuing where nothing of its organization of distinctions was transmitted or ending where it was, so that concepts need a criterion of their own; or a reflexive social system in which interventions on will-organization, with interpretation held fixed (A43 §10's design), leave the system's concepts and organizations unchanged over the horizon studied, so that the conditioning runs one way only. Also defeated as a thesis of its own if it only restates the owner's [CLAIM-336](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-336.md) (meaning and will as one model) with [CLAIM-402](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-402.md)'s categories confirmed through use, adding nothing about individuation. Not defeated by a concept that persists though it is false, which the claim allows.
## Formal apparatus

results that hold whatever any substantive line concludes — gluing and contextuality, comparison of experiments and probes, identifiability, conservation, and thresholds for naming a unit; held as a second line by the general results other lines borrow, so that setting a substantive line aside does not retire them ([ADR-040](../record/decisions.d/ADR-040.md))

- [SYNTHESIS-008](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-008.md), set out under its first line: Structural frustration of a set of demands forces, under every attainable arrangement, some member whose demand is unmet while it acts toward it, the precondition of operative thwarting, exactly when no attainable arrangement leaves each member either met or quiet; lying outside both the requirement complex and the quiescent complex does not suffice, the requirement complex is the test when every member acts whenever its demand is unmet, and in a minimal such conflict each member is the unmet, acting one under some arrangement and none is under all
## Resource-bounded realizability and individuation

what a constrained system can realize, reach, tell apart and become under computational and physical bounds — compatibility against reachability, budgeted composition of processes, finding against navigating, restricted and enriched Yoneda profiles, isomorphism against persistence, with origami as the laboratory ([ADR-073](../record/decisions.d/ADR-073.md))

- [SYNTHESIS-003](../record/syntheses.d/SYNTHESIS-003.md), set out under its first line: When an organized individual persists through changes of state and mode, in the dynamical and historical senses of persistence, what persists is the particular organization that keeps its repertoire realizable, not the repertoire it keeps, nor any state, mode or boundary; that organization may lie inside the individual or outside it
